TestUpgradeFullPath::test_cluster_upgrad.description: Starts a 3-rack/3-node cluster on release:2025.1 (no boot speedups), creates ks.cf (RF3) with 99 rows, then for each hop of the full path 2025.1 -> 2025.3 -> 2025.4 -> 2026.1 -> version under test upgrades all nodes via cluster.upgrade_cluster, reconnects the driver, validates existing rows with assert_all at QUORUM, inserts 100 more rows, flushes and validates all rows. Before upgrading from 2026.1+ it waits for schema-on-raft, triggers the gossip->raft topology upgrade (POST /storage_service/raft_topology/upgrade) and waits for service levels v2, as required since 2026.2 dropped gossip topology. Guards data integrity and startup across the supported multi-hop upgrade path (e.g. SCYLLADB-1884 group0_schema_version startup failure, SCYLLADB-1198 SL v2 timeout).

TestUpgradeClusterWithEnableDisableTWCSQ.description: Starts a 3-rack/3-node cluster on release:2026.1, creates a TWCS table (5-minute windows) filled via simulate_write_process_in_minutes, records the results of 5 time-range queries, then upgrades nodes one by one to the version under test; after each node upgrade it ALTERs the table toggling 'enable_optimized_twcs_queries' false/true and asserts the query results equal the pre-upgrade snapshot (validate_twcs_data, exact ==, upgrade_test.py:161-163). Before upgrading it enables raft topology + waits for SL v2 when not already enabled. Guards the TWCS optimized-query option (scylla commit 168c6f47) and schema ALTERs in a mixed-version cluster.
